# Production Readiness

## Objective

Prepare the IVPC platform for:

- scientific production;
- operational reproducibility;
- auditability;
- AI-assisted development.

---

# Required production capabilities

## Observability

The platform must expose:

- structured logs;
- execution events;
- pipeline telemetry.

---

## Runtime validation

All critical outputs must use:

- zod validation;
- explicit schemas;
- runtime contracts.

---

## CI/CD gates

All pull requests must validate:

- lint;
- typecheck;
- semantic tests;
- report tests;
- regression tests.

---

# Mandatory production guarantees

The system must preserve:

- semantic consistency;
- methodological consistency;
- spatial consistency;
- statistical consistency.
